1.

Blessed assurance, Jesus is mine! He is my Shepherd, calls me His own. Blessed assurance, all is now well! Jesus has redeemed my body and my soul.

C.

He is my joy, He is my song, Him I praise all the day long. He is my joy, He is my song, Him I praise all the day long.

2.

All I surrendered, all I have gained, The eternal day has gloriously dawned. Heaven is open, angels from God Bring to the earth the message of salvation.

3.

Now I can blessedly sing His praise, My soul now enjoys heaven’s food. I am but dust, yet cleansed by God, Jesus is mine, and I am His bride.

4.

Baptized with God’s Spirit according to His word, Blessed assurance, heaven on earth! Fire on my tongue, fire in my breast, He has filled me with love so warm.
